summary: Mined learned concepts with stable IDs, mutable display names, CANDIDATE→OBSERVING→ACTIVE lifecycle plus conservative merge/split — no enum, no schema migration
implementation: src/shared/learned-concept.ts: ConceptStatus (CANDIDATE/OBSERVING/ACTIVE/SPLIT/MERGED/DEPRECATED) + conceptIsUsable; ConceptPrototype (structural signature + optional embedding ref + tokens); LearnedConcept (stable conceptId, mutable displayName, prototype, support, parent/merged/split pointers, episodeIds); structuralSignature (role+capabilities+modality+specificity/context buckets); tokensOfSignature; prototypeSimilarity (Jaccard); cosineSimilarity; conceptIdForSignature; displayNameForSignature

electron/learning/concepts/concept-registry.ts: ConceptRegistry — durable registry with prototype index; find (exact signature → token similarity); upsert/reinforce (idempotent per episodeId, lifecycle promotion at observing/activation support); rename (display name only, identity/history untouched); absorb (merge: absorbed ⇒ MERGED + mergedInto pointer, history preserved); split (parent ⇒ SPLIT + splitInto, children with parentConceptId); deprecate/setStatus; usable(); corrupt file degrades to no concepts

electron/learning/concepts/concept-miner.ts: ConceptMiner — deterministic structural clustering of episode fingerprints (support threshold), idempotent re-mining, per-cluster error capture (never throws)
electron/learning/concepts/concept-merge.ts: findMergeCandidates (similarity threshold + sustained outcome consistency over enough samples) + applyMerge
electron/learning/concepts/concept-split.ts: proposeSplit (bimodal behaviour with min samples per side + mean separation) + applySplit
tests: tests/unit/engine-phase-7.test.ts (9 tests): contract determinism (bucketed signatures, Jaccard/cosine, status usability); A21 new cluster ⇒ concept with no enum change (and a second cluster later); lifecycle promotion by support; A22 rename keeps id/history and prototype lookup; re-mining is idempotent and survives restart; A29 corrupt registry degrades plus a failing mine() run is contained; merge of semantic neighbours preserves history via MERGED pointer; split of bimodal behaviour keeps parent SPLIT with history; no split proposal for uniform behaviour
notes: Two real defects were found and fixed while writing these tests: concept support double-counted on re-mining, and the test fixture's 'partial completion' actually mapped to the 0.5 axis.
